description:
Primary Responsibilities: 
 The Python Developer will create web applications using primarily Python
 Work closely with our product and design teams to define feature specifications
 The Python Developer will work closely with operations and infrastructure to build and scale back-end services
 Build report interfaces and data feeds 
 JOB REQUIREMENTS 
 Working on the Cloud Automation Provisioning System for Middleware, an internal system used by the client internally to provision their middleware systems. The project uses the latest technologies to build innovative Cloud Automation for Middleware Platforms . Looking for experienced python developers who are well versed in working with Agile development and utilizing continuous integration and delivery practices 

 Day to Day: Develop, attend: daily stand ups/weekly status meetings, testing.  

 other Necessary Skills: Excellent Communication Skills, team player, working with remote teams. 

 Work well in highly collaborative teams 

 Expertise with Python (4-5 + years’ experience with large scale applications)
 Experience with Python web frameworks ( Django Pyramid Flask )
 Experience with orchestration related service Mistral, Stackstorm
 Knowledge of relational databases and SQL, preferably PostgreSQL
 Knowledge of web technologies: XHTML, JavaScript
 Experience with deploying web applications on cloud infrastructure
 The Python Developer needs to take pride in principled design, elegant abstractions and clean code
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 12 Months
